title: A refused outbound call: read it, allow it, or open it in an emergency
caption: docs/mvp/runbooks/outbound-allow-list.md §2–§4; deploy/egress/allowed-hosts.conf; deploy/scripts/egress.sh.

steps.title: Read the refusal
steps.expect: The refused destination and the user (zone) that tried.

steps.title: Check the table
steps.expect: PASS lines, or FAIL naming the line without an address or an extra destination.

steps.title: Add a host by pull request
steps.body: Add `host port proto user reason` to `deploy/egress/allowed-hosts.conf`; after merge and deploy run `sudo bash /srv/velexis/current/deploy/scripts/provision-vm.sh --steps egress`.
steps.expect: `velexis-egress validate` accepts the file; addresses appear within 2 minutes.

steps.title: Emergency opening (outage only)
steps.body: Record the incident first, then `sudo nft add element inet velexis_egress emergency4 '{ 198.51.100.7 . tcp . 443 timeout 4h comment "INC-… reason, name" }'`.
steps.expect: check-vm.sh reports `an emergency opening is in place` until it expires; review within a working day.
